name: TWF Opening Notices

date.source: The posts' own shared Usenet dateline.

no_appearances_reason: Three same-day operational/recruitment notices (a newsletter-writer call, the fed's own recruitment ad, an IRC channel notice); no match, angle or roster result is staged.
notes: The fed's own earliest surviving documents, moving this wing's own attested founding date six months earlier than the held 9 April 1997 sole document (see registry correction). The recruitment ad's own tagline matches the wing's registered house_style text verbatim.

name: TWF - Tournament to be held... ALL WELCOME!
notes: Announces a tournament to determine the next challenger for the TWF World Championship, held by the American Patriot -- a self-portrayed persona of the post's own signer, "Will".

name: TWF HouseShow Results
notes: A full house-show card: an Iron Man Match (Da SoulTaker over Raven S. Bridges, 11 falls to 6); Shadow pins Da Crypt with the Light's Out; a Submission Match in which the World Champion, the American Patriot, makes Tywon (an in-fiction self-portrayal by the fed's own operator, per the coordinator's scoped allow -- see a workshop file) submit to a figure-four sleeper, retaining the TWF World Championship; The Outlaw defeats Da Dungeonmaster by disqualification; Ultimo pins The Master Of Pain after a high cross body.
